diff --git a/scripts/prepare_release.py b/scripts/prepare_release.py
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..c5534298d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/scripts/prepare_release.py
@@ -0,0 +1,25 @@
+"""Orchestrate release preparation tasks."""
+
+import sys
+from scripts.add_latest_release_date import main as add_date_main
+
+def main() -> None:
+    print("Preparing release...")
+
+    # 1. Add latest release date to release notes
+    print("Adding latest release date...")
+    try:
+        add_date_main()
+    except SystemExit as e:
+        if e.code == 0:
+            print("Release date already exists or was added.")
+        elif e.code == 1:
+            print("Error: No release header found in release notes.")
+        else:
+            print(f"Error occurred while adding release date: {e}")
+            sys.exit(e.code)
+
+    print("Release preparation complete!")
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
